title: Disclaimer | Unique Visa Services Ltd
description: Unique Visa Services Ltd is a private, IAA-regulated visa and immigration service, not affiliated with any government, embassy or consulate.
intro: Unique Visa Services Ltd is a private visa assistance provider based in the UK. We specialise in professional support and guidance for individuals and businesses applying for visas for international travel. Please read this disclaimer carefully before using our services.

sections.heading: Independent visa assistance provider
sections.text:
Unique Visa Services Ltd is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any government authority, embassy or consulate. We are an independent organisation that provides visa support services for UK citizens and residents travelling abroad.

Our team helps applicants prepare, review and submit their visa applications for many countries. However, the final decision to approve or refuse a visa always rests with the relevant government authority or consulate.

sections.heading: Range of visa application assistance
sections.text:
We help UK citizens and residents apply for visas to a wide range of destinations, including but not limited to:
- China: tourist, business, work and conference visas
- India: tourist, business, medical and other eVisas and visa categories
- Russia: tourist, business and work visas
- Saudi Arabia: family visit, business and religious travel visas
- Sri Lanka: ETA tourist and business visas
- Ghana: tourist and business visa applications
- Australia: visitor, business and study visa guidance
- Schengen area: tourist, business and conference visas for European countries
- USA: visitor, business, student and work visa support
- UK: various visa categories for international applicants

Our services cover applications for tourism, work, business, conferences, study, medical treatment, journalism and other visa categories.

sections.heading: Consultation fees
sections.text:
We charge a professional consultation and service fee for helping with visa applications. This fee is separate from government or consular visa application charges. All fees are clearly explained to applicants before the service begins.

Applicants also have the option to apply directly through the relevant country's official government or consulate website, without using our services.

sections.heading: Immigration advice and legal advice
sections.text:
Unique Visa Services Ltd is not a firm of solicitors. We are immigration advisers regulated by the Immigration Advice Authority (IAA), reference F200700144, and we give UK immigration advice only within the level and categories we are authorised for. For travel visas to other countries, our service is limited to visa guidance, document checking and application support.

If your case needs advice or representation beyond our authorisation, we will tell you and recommend that you seek help from a solicitor or another suitably regulated adviser.

sections.heading: Transparency and responsibility
sections.text:
While we work to ensure accuracy and efficiency in your visa application, we cannot guarantee that a visa will be approved. Approval or refusal of an application is solely at the discretion of the relevant government authority or embassy.

We make every effort to keep our website and information up to date, but applicants should always check official government websites for the latest requirements, forms and fees.

sections.heading: Official consulate and government websites
sections.text:
For transparency, you can also visit the official consulate or government websites of the countries you plan to travel to:
- [China visa: Ministry of Foreign Affairs](https://www.fmprc.gov.cn/)
- [India visa: Ministry of Home Affairs](https://www.mha.gov.in/MHA1/TourVisa.html)
- [Russia visa: Ministry of Foreign Affairs](https://mid.ru/en/)
- [Saudi Arabia visa: Ministry of Foreign Affairs](https://visa.mofa.gov.sa/)
- [Sri Lanka ETA](https://eta.gov.lk/)
- [Ghana: Ghana High Commission, London](https://london.mfa.gov.gh/)
- [Australia visa: Department of Home Affairs](https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/)
- [Schengen visa information: European Commission](https://home-affairs.ec.europa.eu/)
- [USA visa: U.S. Department of State](https://travel.state.gov/)
- [UK visa: GOV.UK](https://www.gov.uk/apply-uk-visa)

sections.heading: Final note
sections.text: By using our services, applicants acknowledge that Unique Visa Services Ltd is a private visa assistance provider and not a government authority. We are committed to offering professional support and making the visa application process easier, but the responsibility for approval lies entirely with the relevant government, consulate or embassy.
